positive.point: Using AI to brainstorm and implement cybersecurity projects is appreciated as it aligns with organizational goals and leverages AI capabilities.
The open-source security automation platform Shipsec Studio is praised for being free, easy to set up, and offering comprehensive security tools.
The initiative to make cybersecurity accessible for SMEs through playbooks is seen as a much-needed and scalable solution.
The tool built to streamline threat investigation workflows is valued for significantly reducing analysis time and tool switching.
The curated awesome-list for Wazuh is appreciated for being a comprehensive resource for deployment, rules, and integrations.

negative.point: Struggles with deploying a Breach & Attack Simulation lab due to technical issues with OpenAEV and integration challenges.
Frustration with tool fragmentation in threat investigation workflows, leading to the development of a new tool.
Challenges faced by a PhD student in accessing data for research due to budget constraints and lack of support from CTI vendors.
Difficulty in managing a cybersecurity business alone, with too many tasks and the need for collaboration or hiring.
Issues with the virtual browser feature in a newly developed tool, which is broken on Firefox and not optimized for mobile.
